label: Inverter and battery

questions.text: How often does the power go out?
questions.why: Frequent cuts mean more charge and discharge cycles.

questions.text: What runs on the inverter during a cut?
questions.why: Running more than it is rated for overheats it.

questions.text: Where are the inverter and battery kept?
questions.why: They give off heat and gas and need fresh air.

answers.label: In a closed cabinet or small space

questions.text: If the battery has a water level indicator, when was it last checked by a technician?
questions.why: Low water shortens the battery's life.

questions.text: Has the backup time become shorter?
questions.why: Shorter backup is a sign the battery is wearing.

questions.text: Have you noticed beeping, a smell, a swollen battery or corrosion on the terminals?
questions.why: Early signs let you get it checked before a small fault grows.

care_tips.text: If the battery swells, leaks or smells, switch the inverter off and call the brand's service; don't touch the terminals.
care_tips.why: A damaged battery can leak acid or catch fire.

care_tips.text: Switch off the inverter at the mains before cleaning around it.
Don't open the inverter or the battery; leave checks and top-ups to the brand's technician.
care_tips.why: Battery acid and live parts are dangerous.

care_tips.text: Keep the inverter and battery in an open, airy place away from children.
care_tips.why: They give off heat and gas.

care_tips.text: Run only what the inverter is rated for during cuts.
Ask the technician to check the battery's water level at service visits.
care_tips.why: Low water shortens the battery's life.

care_tips.text: If backup time drops a lot or it keeps beeping, contact the brand's service.
care_tips.why: The battery may need a check.

reminders.text: Book an inverter and battery check.
reminders.note: Check your manual and warranty card for the recommended service schedule.

risk_factors.question: cuts_per_week
risk_factors.reason: Daily cuts mean more battery cycles.

risk_factors.question: symptoms
risk_factors.reason: These are signs of a fault.

warranty_structure.note: Covered for a standard period - check your warranty card.
Often split into a full-replacement period and a pro-rata period - check your warranty card.

exclusions_to_look_for: Battery damage from low water or overloading
Physical damage or a broken case
